verdict.rationale: Live Assist shows agents guiding human reps through conversations and capturing context, and release-governance docs describe merge-approval workflows keeping 'a person in the loop' — both point toward human-in-the-loop patterns, but neither documents an explicit per-conversation 'draft reply, human approves before send' supervised mode as the story describes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a message-level draft/approval workflow gating live customer replies, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of such a mode in production.
